query.normalized: revision report
query.original: Revision report

response.sql:
SELECT
  p.project_name AS project,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tl.name ORDER BY tl.name SEPARATOR ', '), ''), 
    primary_tl.name, 
    'Unassigned'
  ) AS team_leader,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cr.id) AS total_revisions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cr.changerequest_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_revisions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cr.changerequest_status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_revisions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cr.changerequest_status = 'Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_revisions
FROM changerequest_management cr
LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = cr.project_id
LEFT JOIN users primary_tl ON primary_tl.id = p.primary_team_leader
LEFT JOIN users tl
  ON FIND_IN_SET(
    CAST(tl.id AS CHAR), 
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.team_leader, ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '\"', '')
  ) > 0
WHERE (NULL IS NULL OR cr.date >= NULL)
  AND (NULL IS NULL OR cr.date <= NULL)
GROUP BY p.id, p.project_name, primary_tl.name
ORDER BY total_revisions DESC, p.project_name
LIMIT 10
response.title: SQL Report

query.normalized: show me top 4 team leaders who has less productivity
query.original: Show me top 4 team leaders who has less productivity

response.sql:
SELECT 
    u.id,
    u.name AS team_leader_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(tr.hours) + SUM(tr.minutes)/60, 0) AS total_hours_worked,
    COUNT(DISTINCT th.task_id) AS tasks_completed,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SUM(tr.hours) + SUM(tr.minutes)/60) > 0 
        THEN COUNT(DISTINCT th.task_id) / (SUM(tr.hours) + SUM(tr.minutes)/60) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS productivity
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN timelog_records tr ON u.id = tr.user_id
LEFT JOIN task_hours th ON u.id = th.user_id
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
    AND (
        u.id = (SELECT primary_team_leader FROM projects WHERE primary_team_leader IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1)
        OR FIND_IN_SET(CAST(u.id AS CHAR), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE((SELECT team_leader FROM projects WHERE team_leader IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1), ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '')) > 0
    )
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY productivity ASC
LIMIT 4
response.title: SQL Report
